title: Scientific Breeding, Reproductive Physiology & Genetic Improvement Strategies for Modern Dairy Cattle
excerpt: Reproduction is the biological engine of dairy farming. Without timely pregnancies, even the best-managed dairy farm will face declining milk yields, economic losses, and genetic stagnation. Modern dairy reproduction is a science that integrates animal physiology, endocrinology, nutritional management, heat detection technologies, breeding techniques such as artificial insemination, and advanced reproductive biotechnologies.This chapter provides a deep, research-grade exploration of the estrous cycle, heat symptoms, semen quality, AI protocols, calving management, fertility optimization, and the emerging role of genomic selection, sexed semen, and embryo transfer in accelerating genetic improvement. Understanding reproduction is essential not only for maintaining a consistent milk cycle but also for building a high-performance herd for the future.
